name: Emergency Response Support System (ERSS)
description: Unified 24/7 national emergency contact for police, fire, and ambulance response across Tamil Nadu.
agency: Ministry of Home Affairs & Tamil Nadu Police

name: Emergency Medical Ambulance Service (GVK-EMRI)
description: 24-hour emergency ambulance dispatch for road accidents, critical trauma, and maternity emergencies.
agency: Health & Family Welfare Dept, Govt. of Tamil Nadu

name: Hosur City Municipal Corporation Toll-Free Control Room
description: Public grievance reporting for drinking water supply disruptions, garbage overflow, streetlights, and drainage issues.

name: TANGEDCO (TNEB) Electricity Complaint Call Centre
description: 24/7 toll-free helpline for reporting electric shock hazards, power blackouts, transformer sparks, and billing grievances.
agency: Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corporation Ltd

name: Tamil Nadu Women Helpline
description: 24-hour toll-free tele-counseling and immediate rescue intervention for women facing domestic distress, harassment, or violence.

name: Childline National Emergency Service
description: 24-hour emergency assistance and protection service for children in need of care and rehabilitation.
agency: Ministry of Women and Child Development
